name: Compare Text Claims and Detect Restatements
jtbd: When two or more descriptions or claim sets may restate, overlap, or use different wording, compare lexical and semantic signals and show the source sentence pairs that need human review.
runtime: Python >=3.11; local CLI and stdio MCP
requires: One or more text pairs with stable IDs; five or more pairs are needed for corpus percentiles
limitations: The semantic/text gap is a paraphrase diagnostic, not novelty, opportunity, or innovation score.
Dense sentence-transformer behavior was not run or validated on this deployment.
